svg.font-family: IBM Plex Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace
svg.text: Daisy Patch SM on four 2×5 sockets
J_SM1..J_SM4, each cut from a 2×10 strip:
solder the sockets, not the module
J_SD (front part: hand-solder its pins here)
BACK, seen from the back: JLC fits the SMD parts; hand-solder U_SM's sockets, J_PWR and J_SD's pins
red square = J_PWR pin 1, -12 V (the stripe of the ribbon); red rings = J_SD's pins (a front part); dot = pad 1, on the SOICs the notch end; red dashed outline = DNP: leave the footprint empty
DETAIL (red corners above), x 214..250 mm of this view = board x 54.8..90.8 mm, y 50..78 mm: J_PWR's neighbours, among them C2, C3 and C5, which carry no reference on the board silk
